origin.description: Bold text for a column title.
origin.details: pillar.bold defaults to false, so the text is usually unchanged. Turn it on and the text is wrapped in the bold open and close codes. An empty string stays empty. A missing value is drawn as the letters NA when bold is on, and stays missing when bold is off.
origin.value: A character vector of the same length.

translation.description: The same bold. None is missing. A string is one element and a list is the vector.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A string, None, a number, or a list of those.

translation.details: pillar.bold defaults to false. Only a real True enables bold. An empty string stays empty. With bold on, a missing value is the letters NA. With bold off, as.character leaves it missing. The open code is ESC [ 1 m and the close code is ESC [ 22 m. Set cli.num_colors first. One color pastes the text.
translation.value: A string when x is a single value, or a list when x is a list.
translation.example:
from cli._options import options as cli_options

cli_options(**{"cli.num_colors": 8})

from pillar.styles import style_bold

print(style_bold("Petal.Width"))
